questions.question: What role is required to activate an entitled GRC ServiceNow Store application?

explanation.correct: The admin role is required to activate an entitled GRC ServiceNow Store application. This role provides the necessary system-level access to install and activate plugins.

wrongAnswers.explanation: The sn_audit.manager role is for managing audit activities, not for plugin activation.
The sn_compliance.admin role is for compliance administration, not plugin activation.
sn_grc.user is not a standard role; the admin role is required for application activation.

references: Activate an entitled GRC ServiceNow Store application

subtopics: Risk and Compliance Personas, Groups and Roles

questions.question: Which roles are required to accept, reject, or cancel an evidence request? (Choose two.)

explanation.correct: Both sn_audit.user AND sn_compliance.manager roles are required to accept, reject, or cancel an evidence request. Users need both roles to perform these evidence management actions.

wrongAnswers.explanation: sn_audit.admin is an administrative role, not the specific combination required for evidence requests.
The itil role is for ITSM functionality, not GRC evidence management.

references: Accept, reject, or cancel evidence request

subtopics: Risk and Compliance Personas, Groups and Roles

questions.question: Who are the primary users of Audit Management?

options.text: Auditors (an independent body, typically reporting to the board of directors)

explanation.correct: Auditors are the primary users of Audit Management. They are typically an independent body reporting to the board of directors, responsible for conducting internal audits.

wrongAnswers.explanation: IT Service Desk analysts use ITSM applications, not Audit Management.
HR managers use HR Service Delivery, not Audit Management.
Procurement specialists are not the primary users of Audit Management.

source.excerpt: Audit Management users: Auditors (an independent body, typically reporting to the board of directors).

subtopics: Risk and Compliance Personas, Groups and Roles

questions.question: When activating a GRC application from the ServiceNow Store, what happens to dependency plugins starting with Orlando?

options.text: They must be manually activated before the core application
They are automatically activated when you activate the core application
They require a separate license entitlement
They are downloaded but not activated

explanation.correct: Starting with Orlando, dependency plugins are automatically activated when you activate a core application.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Manual activation is not required; dependencies auto-activate.
Dependencies are included with the core application entitlement.
They are both downloaded and activated automatically.

questions.question: Which GRC application is an exception to the automatic dependency plugin activation rule?

explanation.correct: Vendor Risk Management is the exception — its dependencies must be activated manually before activating the core application.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Audit Management follows the standard auto-activation rule.
Policy and Compliance follows the standard rule.
Risk Management follows the standard rule.

questions.question: What happens if you do not select 'Load demo data' during initial GRC application installation?

options.text: Demo data can be installed later from Application Manager
Demo data is not available to install later without a workaround
The application installs without any configuration
Demo data is automatically loaded on next restart

explanation.correct: If you do not select Load demo data during initial installation, demo data is not available to install from Application Manager later. A workaround from the HI Knowledge Base is required.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Demo data cannot be easily installed later through normal means.
The application installs normally but without demo data.
Demo data is not loaded automatically on restart.

questions.question: Which role is required to activate an entitled GRC ServiceNow Store application?

explanation.correct: The admin role is required to activate an entitled GRC application from the ServiceNow Store.

wrongAnswers.explanation: sn_grc.manager is for GRC management tasks, not application activation.
sn_audit.admin is for audit administration, not application activation.
sn_grc.user is a basic GRC role insufficient for activation.

questions.question: Which two steps are part of the GRC application activation process? (Choose two.)

options.text: Navigate to System Applications > All Available Applications > All
Install the dependencies plugin before the core application
Configure LDAP integration for GRC roles
Click Install on the core product after activating dependencies

explanation.correct: The activation process involves navigating to System Applications > All Available Applications > All, then installing dependency plugins followed by the core product.

wrongAnswers.explanation: LDAP integration is not part of the GRC activation process.
For most GRC apps (except VRM), dependencies auto-activate; this step is only needed for VRM.

questions.question: Where does the GRC application activation take place in ServiceNow?

options.text: System Applications > All Available Applications > All

explanation.correct: GRC applications are activated through System Applications > All Available Applications > All.

wrongAnswers.explanation: This is not the correct navigation path for application activation.
While plugins are involved, the entry point is System Applications.
This navigation path does not exist for activation.

questions.question: An administrator is planning to install Audit Management on a sub-production instance. What is the recommended approach for dependency plugins?

options.text: Manually install each dependency plugin individually
Skip dependencies and install only the core application
Let dependencies auto-activate when installing the core application (Orlando+)
Create a custom installation script for dependencies

explanation.correct: Starting with Orlando, dependency plugins auto-activate when you activate a core application. For Audit Management, steps for manual dependency activation are optional.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Manual installation is unnecessary for most GRC apps since Orlando.
Dependencies are needed and will auto-install.
No custom script is needed; auto-activation handles this.
